Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 2026

At SRTConverters.com, accessible from https://srtconverters.com, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document describes the types of information collected and recorded by SRTConverters.com and how we use it.

1. 100% Client-Side Processing Guarantee

SRTConverters.com is built on a privacy-first, client-side architecture.

When you use our subtitle conversion tools (such as TXT to SRT, SRT to Text, SRT to VTT, or VTT to SRT), all file reading, text manipulation, timecode calculations, and file formatting take place entirely inside your web browser using standard client-side Web APIs (such as HTML5 FileReader and JavaScript).

  • Your uploaded text and subtitle files are never transmitted to or stored on our servers.
  • We do not inspect, log, monitor, or retain any dialogue, transcripts, scripts, or video captions you process.
  • When you close your browser tab or reload the page, all processed text is immediately cleared from your device's memory.

2. Log Files & Technical Information

Like most website operators, our hosting and content delivery network (CDN) infrastructure automatically collects standard web server log information when you access our website.

This information may include:

  • Internet Protocol (IP) addresses
  • Browser type and version
  • Operating system and device category
  • Date and time stamps of requests
  • Referring and exit pages

This information is not linked to any personally identifiable information. We use this technical data exclusively for server administration, security monitoring, diagnosing technical issues, preventing malicious traffic (such as DDoS attacks), and ensuring website availability and performance.

3. Cookies and Local Storage

Local Storage

We use browser localStorage solely to remember your preferred visual theme (Light Mode or Dark Mode). This setting is stored locally on your device and is never sent to our servers.

Cookies

We do not use first-party tracking cookies to build personal user profiles. However, third-party partners and advertising services that operate on our website may use cookies and web beacons as described below.

4. Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising

To keep our subtitle conversion utilities free for everyone, we may display advertisements served by Google AdSense and other third-party advertising partners.

  • Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies (including the DoubleClick / DART cookie) to serve ads on our site based on users' visits to SRTConverters.com and other websites on the internet.
  • These third-party ad servers or networks use technology in their advertisements and links that appear on SRTConverters.com, which are sent directly to your browser. They automatically receive your IP address when this happens.
  • Third-party advertisers may also use cookies, JavaScript, or Web Beacons to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns and/or to personalize the advertising content that you see.

Opting Out of Personalized Advertising: Visitors may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings or through the Network Advertising Initiative opt-out portal at aboutads.info.

Please note that SRTConverters.com has no access to or control over cookies used by third-party advertisers.

5. Analytics

We may use aggregated, privacy-conscious website analytics to measure overall website traffic, page views, and geographic usage patterns. These analytics help us understand which tools are most useful and optimize website performance. Analytics data is collected in aggregate form and does not track individual identity or file contents.

6. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external third-party websites (such as video platforms, video editing software documentation, or web standards specifications). If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that site. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party websites or services.

7. Children's Privacy

Protecting the privacy of children is important to us. SRTConverters.com does not knowingly collect any personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13. If you believe that a child has provided personal information on our website, please contact us immediately, and we will promptly remove such information from our records.

8. Your Privacy Rights (GDPR, CCPA & Global Regulations)

Depending on your jurisdiction (such as under the European General Data Protection Regulation / GDPR or California Consumer Privacy Act / CCPA), you may have specific privacy rights regarding your personal information, including:

  • The right to know what personal data is collected, used, or disclosed.
  • The right to request deletion of personal information held about you.
  • The right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data for cross-context behavioral advertising.
  • The right to non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights.

Because our conversion tools operate strictly client-side and do not collect user accounts, names, or file contents, we do not maintain personal profiles or store user-submitted transcripts. For any general privacy inquiries or requests regarding server log records, please contact us.

9. Data Security

We implement standard industry security practices to protect our website. All traffic to and from SRTConverters.com is encrypted using modern Transport Layer Security (TLS/HTTPS). Because file conversions run locally in your browser, your sensitive subtitle content is never exposed to server-side transmission risks.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our operational practices, tool capabilities, or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted directly on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

11. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:

Email: contact@srtconverters.com
